correctness.rationale: The coherently oriented rim multipath complex is the boundary of the n-vertex rim simplex S^{n-2}. The first length-two shortcut has link partial Delta of n-2 remaining rim arcs and adds S^{n-3}. For the second shortcut, the exact link is A=partial Delta(E\{e_d,e_{d+1}}) augmented by a cone on a simplex for adjacent starts (no new lower sphere), or a cone on the boundary of the n-4-arc simplex for nonadjacent starts (adds S^{n-5} to the link). The only cycle involving both nonadjacent shortcuts uses every remaining allowed rim arc. Connectivity of S^{n-2} vee S^{n-3} makes each second link inclusion nullhomotopic, giving S^{n-2} vee 2S^{n-3}, with an extra S^{n-4} iff d>=2. Null cone attachments relative to deletion yield split homotopy inclusions; n>=6 prevents degenerate boundary issues. Independently enumerated all directed arc subsets, link constraints and Euler values n=6..9, every permitted d; modular checker source examined; finite data does not establish integral homotopy by itself.
residual_risks: Only two forward length-two shortcuts and n>=6; no extensions to 3 shortcuts, arbitrary orientations or equivariant splittings.
